name: chat_with_meerkat
title: Chat with Meerkat
description: Meerkat, the prompt engineer behind getmeerkat.dev, writes or revises a prompt from a short conversation about it. Takes the turns of the conversation that are about the prompt being worked on (the user's request, later instructions about it, and Meerkat's earlier replies), oldest first and ending with a user turn, plus an optional working style. Returns Meerkat's reply in plain text, the current draft prompt (empty when Meerkat asks a clarifying question instead), 2 to 5 suggested follow-ups, a short title, a critique when revising a pasted prompt, and a record of which models drafted and merged the draft. When a draft is produced, the turns sent and Meerkat's reply are saved to the user's Meerkat shelf.

role.description: 'user' for the person's turns, 'assistant' for Meerkat's earlier replies about this prompt.

messages.description: The turns of the conversation that are about the prompt being worked on, oldest first: the user's request, later instructions about the prompt, and Meerkat's earlier replies. The last turn is from the user. Only these turns are sent to Meerkat and saved with the draft.

archetype.description: Optional working style: 'writer' (copy for people to read), 'builder' (a prompt wired into an app or agent) or 'operator' (get the task done with few questions). Defaults to 'writer'.

reply.description: Meerkat's reply, plain text, usually 1 to 3 sentences.

prompt.description: The current draft prompt. Empty when Meerkat asked a clarifying question instead.

chips.description: 2 to 5 short suggested follow-ups, each 24 characters or fewer.

title.description: A 3 to 5 word title describing what the prompt does.

critique.description: On revisions of a pasted prompt: 'wins' lists what the original did well, 'fixes' lists each problem and the change made. Null otherwise.

labs.description: Frontier labs that wrote an independent candidate this turn.

count.description: Number of independent drafts merged (excludes the synthesizer's own).

merger.description: The lab that merged the drafts into the final prompt.

reason.description: Plain-English why this depth was chosen.

roles.description: The distinct angles the panel drafted from.

mode.description: 'first' = drafted from scratch; 'refine' = revised an existing prompt.

synthesis.description: Which frontier labs drafted independent candidates this turn and which one merged them. Null when no panel ran. The reply already ends with a one-line plain-text summary of this.
